therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Stimulation of neutrophil production and mobilization
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Bone marrow protection during radiation therapy by mobilizing hematopoietic cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with cervix cancer and endometrial cancer receiving radiation therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Number of participants achieving recommended phase 2 dose criteria (SUVmean ≥2.5 on FDG-PET with normalized WBC/ANC)

results.effect_size: Cohort 1: 3/3 achieved RP2D criteria, Cohort 2: 3/3 achieved RP2D criteria, Cohort 3: 0/0 achieved RP2D criteria
results.target_engagement_evidence: FDG-PET SUVmean measurements used to assess bone marrow activation
biomarker_changes: SUVmean target of 2.5 or higher on D5 FDG PET
WBC and ANC normalization prior to radiation start
results.dose_information: Dose-finding study with 3 cohorts, specific doses not provided

context.duration: Up to 7 weeks after starting treatment
